about: Two invented pages for the contract and the canvas, not for the quality of a model. They are rendered from the OFL handwriting fonts of haex-notes (Caveat, Patrick Hand, Kalam): no student data. The results are recorded outputs of the two-step page job (contracts/page-job.md) from qwen3-vl:4b-instruct on Ollama 0.40.1, temperature 0, on 2026-10-23, with the instructions of pageJob.ts. Re-record them when READ_INSTRUCTION or FIX_INSTRUCTION change.

fixtures.description: A heading, four lines of text with the misspelling "Seure", a table of three columns and three rows, and a sketch of a beaker with an arrow.

regions.text:
Säuren schmecken sauer und färben Lackmus rot.
Basen fühlen sich seifig an. Lösungen von Basen
färben Lackmus blau. Der pH-Wert sagt, wie stark
eine Seure oder Base ist (0 bis 14).
